notes: Tool names are stable machine identifiers; never localized.

Every invocation passes three gates in order: known tool -> user toggle (Settings > Device tools) -> Android runtime permission. Any failure returns {"ok": false, ...}; treat non-ok as 'the action did not happen'.
Permissions named here are checked at call time (fail-closed). Grant them in system Settings (Apps > LEVI > Permissions).
params use JSON-schema-ish shapes: {name, type (string|integer|boolean), required, description, default?}.

tools.description: Posts a notification on this device with a title and body. Tapping it opens LEVI.
tools.name: notify

tools.description: Opens the system calendar editor pre-filled with the event. No calendar permission is needed: the user confirms the event on screen, so a launch does not guarantee creation.
tools.name: calendar_event

params.description: Start time, epoch millis. Defaults to now.
params.name: start_millis

params.description: End time, epoch millis. Defaults to start + 1h.
params.name: end_millis

tools.description: Hands an alarm or countdown timer to the system clock app via the platform alarm intents.
tools.name: alarm

params.description: Try to set without showing the clock UI.
params.name: skip_ui

tools.description: Returns a coarse network/IP-based position estimate (latitude, longitude, accuracy in meters, fix time). City-block level at best; never treat as precise. Read only at invocation time — never tracked in the background.
tools.name: location_coarse

tools.description: Opens an http(s) link in the device's default browser. Only http and https schemes are accepted.
tools.name: open_url

params.description: http(s) URL to open in the default browser.
params.name: url

tools.description: Opens a file from the app's own storage in its default app via a read-only content URI. Paths outside the app's own storage are refused.
tools.name: open_file

params.description: Absolute path to a file inside the app's own storage.
params.name: path

tools.description: Returns the device's current time: epoch millis, ISO-8601 timestamp, timezone ID and UTC offset.
tools.name: local_time

tools.description: Hands a query to the device's default search handler. Results stay in that app; nothing is returned to the agent.
tools.name: web_search

tools.description: Fetches an HTTPS URL and returns the body text to the agent. Plain HTTP is refused; responses are capped in size (256KB) and time; redirects are followed only to https. Must be called off the main thread.
tools.name: fetch_url

params.description: HTTPS URL to fetch. Plain HTTP is refused.
params.name: url
